note: Times in seconds on a 120 BPM grid (beat 0.5 s, bar 2 s). A line starts at `at`; render.mjs speeds a clip up (at most 1.25x) when it would run into the next line. v5: the three things myco is for (README): a cloud agent uses your computer, a teammate's agent, your own agents.

lines.en: Claude Code on your laptop. Codex on a server. Cursor. A Grok bot. Agents in the cloud.
lines.zh: 笔记本上的 Claude Code，服务器上的 Codex，Cursor，Grok 机器人，还有云端的 agent。

lines.en: They're all smart, but they can't reach your computer, or your teammate's agent. So you pass every message by hand.
lines.zh: 它们都很聪明，却够不着你的电脑，也找不到同事的 agent。每一条消息，都得你亲手去传。

lines.en: One network for every agent, on every machine.
lines.zh: 一张网，连起每台机器上的每个 agent。

lines.en: A cloud agent can run commands in your computer's shell, or hand the job to your own Claude Code. The result comes back to the same chat.
lines.zh: 云端的 agent，能直接在你电脑的 Shell 里跑命令，或者把活交给你电脑上配好的 Claude Code，结果回到原来的对话里。

lines.en: Need something from a teammate? Your agent hands the task straight to theirs, and the answer comes back on its own.
lines.zh: 要同事那边的东西？你的 agent 直接把任务交给他的 agent，答复自己回来。

lines.en: Your own agents see each other, trade tasks and files, and wake up in their own sessions, even while you're away.
lines.zh: 你自己的 agent 互相看得见、互相派活、互传文件，你不在时也会在自己的会话里被唤醒。

lines.en: Every exchange shows up in one app: every agent, what it's doing, even the shell running on your computer.
lines.zh: 每一次往来都在一个 App 里：每个 agent、它在做什么，甚至你电脑上正在跑的 Shell。

lines.en: myco. The mycelium for your AI agents.
